title: Temporary profile percentage for a duration set does not end.
body:
**AndroidAPS 3.3.0-dev-e**
**Build:** 859764d2ce4fc3359c4fe4e243a89466fc5aa996
**Flavor:** Fullrelease

**Problem description:**

Temporary profile percentage for the duration set does not end.
Temporary target was manually to 80% for a duration of 180 minutes at 02:09hrs.
In overview at 0918hrs it is still active, showing negative time of 9 minutes. At that time however, 80% profile is still active and does not change/progress.

**Additional information**
Problem looks similar to issue https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/issues/2538

_Logfiles_
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1733905150983.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18092575/AndroidAPS_LOG_1733905150983.log.zip)
